C0306.title: Beijing Haidian DDoS Attack Platform Case
C0306.summary: The Supreme People's Procuratorate reported that a DDoS attack platform case prosecuted by the Haidian District Procuratorate in Beijing received a first-instance judgment on July 17, 2020. The defendant Wang built a dedicated online DDoS attack platform and openly sold attack packages labeled bronze, silver, gold, and diamond. After users placed orders and paid fees, they could maliciously attack target websites. The court convicted Wang of illegally using information networks and sentenced him to one year in prison and a 50,000 yuan fine.
